tasks.label: Run Authentication Service
tasks.command: cd backend/auth_service && uv run --extra shared --extra auth_service fastapi dev main.py --port 8000

tasks.label: Run Users Service
tasks.command: cd backend/users_service && uv run --extra shared --extra users_service fastapi dev main.py --port 8001

tasks.label: Run Profiles Service
tasks.command: cd backend/profiles_service && uv run --extra shared --extra profiles_service fastapi dev main.py --port 8002
